subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid x-openclaw-agent-id make OpenAI-compatible HTTP requests tolerate a generic body model, and should that rule apply across Chat Completions, Responses, and Embeddings?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the requested behavior changes a documented public API contract for model selection and could create endpoint parity differences.

options.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers choose one precedence rule for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint family, then implement it once.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat body model as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, with docs and tests for every endpoint maintainers want covered.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Keep requiring model to be openclaw, openclaw/default, or an agent-target model and document SDK integrations to send that value plus optional x-openclaw-model.

recommendation.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this open until maintainers choose one precedence rule for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint family, then implement it once.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced and recently maintained the agent-first model contract that this issue would change.
